app_user_password_contract.name: app_user_password_contract
app_user_password_contract.value:
(
        "app_user"."account_type" = 'demo'
        AND "app_user"."password_hash" IS NULL
        AND "app_user"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "app_user"."account_type" = 'human'
        AND "app_user"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL
      )

menu_item_route_contract.name: menu_item_route_contract
menu_item_route_contract.value:
(
        "menu_item"."kind" = 'group'
        AND "menu_item"."route_path" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "menu_item"."kind" = 'page'
        AND "menu_item"."route_path" IS NOT NULL
      )

source_revision_effective_range.name: source_revision_effective_range
source_revision_effective_range.value: "source_revision"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "source_revision"."effective_from" IS NULL OR "source_revision"."effective_to" >= "source_revision"."effective_from"
